content: Production exchange bot architectures separate an OMS (order state machine with explicit terminal states) from an exchange-integration layer (auth/signing/rate-limits/WS) and run a periodic reconciliation job that diffs local DB order/position state against exchange-reported state. Idempotency is enforced via client-order-id plus 'check-before-retry-on-timeout' logic (never blind retry). An independent watchdog process is recommended separate from the main trading loop so a hung/crashed trader doesn't also disable the safety monitor.
